components.label: Color roles
components.usage: Use semantic roles from tokens.json; status includes readable text.

components.label: Typography
components.usage: UI labels and values stay distinct; serif belongs to reading content.

components.label: Spacing and geometry
components.usage: Use the shared spacing rhythm and theme metrics.

components.label: Icons
components.usage: Icon-only actions require accessible names.

components.label: Motion
components.usage: Respect reduced motion; motion must not carry essential information.

components.label: Button
components.usage: Choose one dominant action per task.

components.label: Icon button
components.usage: Use a label when the icon is ambiguous.

components.label: Toolbar
components.usage: Group related actions without duplicating page navigation.

components.label: Menu
components.usage: Object commands belong near their object.

components.label: Command palette
components.usage: Expose commands with names and keyboard access.

components.label: Text input
components.usage: Keep the label visible and preserve edits on validation failure.

components.label: Text area
components.usage: Allow useful working space for longer input.

components.label: Number input
components.usage: Show units and valid bounds where relevant.

components.label: Select
components.usage: Use meaningful option labels.

components.label: Checkbox
components.usage: Use for independent choices.

components.label: Radio group
components.usage: Use for mutually exclusive visible choices.

components.label: Switch
components.usage: Use for a directly applied on/off setting.

components.label: Slider
components.usage: Expose the value and allow keyboard adjustment.

components.label: Date and time
components.usage: Use platform input semantics and a readable current value.

components.label: File selection
components.usage: Keep file selection local and display the selected names.

components.label: Color selection
components.usage: Provide a readable color value.

components.label: Section rail
components.usage: Selects the top-level section.

components.label: Sidebar
components.usage: Compose a section rail and a sidebar listing every page of the area, as a collapsible tree (NavTree) when there are many. Preserve each section selection; provide pointer and keyboard width adjustment, collapse and restore. The expanded sidebar pushes the work area and never becomes an overlay.

components.label: Tabs
components.usage: Use one row of connected peer-view or document tabs with a top active edge and shared content surface; keep panels mounted and associate each tab with its panel. Never stack a tab row under or inside another; groups stay in the same row and document tabs close immediately.

components.label: Breadcrumbs
components.usage: Show an actual hierarchy rather than a second page title.

components.label: Pagination
components.usage: Keep result and page counts consistent.

components.label: Panel
components.usage: Group related work; do not box every sentence.

components.label: Disclosure
components.usage: Hide optional detail, never required actions or blocking errors.

components.label: Split pane
components.usage: Resize by pointer or keyboard; restore the previous width.

components.label: Stack and separator
components.usage: Compose existing controls with shared spacing.

components.label: Settings row
components.usage: Keep the setting label, control and consequential explanation together.

components.label: List
components.usage: Use for scanning items without cross-column comparisons.

components.label: Data table
components.usage: Preserve sorting, filtering and selected rows across navigation.

components.label: Tree
components.usage: Use for real parent-child structure with keyboard navigation.

components.label: Item grid
components.usage: Use when visual identity matters to the task.

components.label: Status indicator
components.usage: Pair semantic color with readable state.

components.label: Inline alert
components.usage: Keep consequences and recovery visible near the action.

components.label: Progress
components.usage: Distinguish running, paused, cancelled and complete.

components.label: Notification
components.usage: Use for nonblocking updates; keep important outcomes available.

components.label: Empty and unavailable states
components.usage: Distinguish these conditions and offer a useful action.

components.label: Loading
components.usage: Label the operation without inventing progress.

components.label: Dialog
components.usage: Restore focus after dismissal; reserve blocking interactions for decisions.

components.label: Detail drawer
components.usage: Use when details need more room without replacing the current task.

components.label: Question-mark help
components.usage: Hover or focus previews; click pins; Escape or outside click dismisses.

components.label: Tooltip
components.usage: Optional brief context, never the only source of essential information.

components.label: Reading surface
components.usage: Use a readable line length and editorial hierarchy.

components.label: Code and log output
components.usage: Preserve whitespace and provide useful copying.

components.label: Media frame
components.usage: Keep a textual alternative and useful controls.

components.label: Chart
components.usage: Show units and labels with a readable data alternative.

components.label: Canvas and inspector
components.usage: Keep selection and zoom while the inspector changes details.

components.label: Stub
components.usage: Mark development stand-in content as a Stub. It is striped, and release builds fail until each one is replaced. Hint text inside inputs is not a Stub.

components.label: Layout composition
components.usage: Compose the same components for the product task, retaining capabilities.

layouts.label: Focused utility
layouts.description: One task with its options and outcome.

layouts.label: Multi-tool utility
layouts.description: Related tools in distinct pages with shared settings.

layouts.label: Embedded utility
layouts.description: A compact task inside a larger surface.

layouts.label: Data application
layouts.description: Filter, compare, select and inspect a collection.

layouts.label: Editor / workbench
layouts.description: Section rail, collapsible sidebar tree, one row of open documents and a bottom panel.

layouts.label: Publication / reference
layouts.description: Readable content with useful document navigation.

layouts.label: Guided workflow
layouts.description: A sequence that preserves input and permits revision.

layouts.label: Monitoring / analysis
layouts.description: Consistent operational state, progress and readable measurements.

systemPages.label: Appearance settings
systemPages.usage: A section of SettingsWindow, opened from the gear or Control comma. Theme belongs here. Showcase comparison controls are local to the showcase and excluded from library exports.

systemPages.label: About
systemPages.usage: A section of SettingsWindow, filled by AboutSection. Product identity is prominent; persistent Stack Junkie Style attribution is compact and reads the imported library version.
